Gangsters

Criminal guilds, crime families, protection rackets, and loan sharks are just a few of the many types of gangs in Absalom Station. Gangs are highly localized, predatory, and extremely territorial. Members join for different reasons, but most find that once they're in a gang, there's no easy way out.

Gangsters always have hustles, criminal industries they use to make money, but most also operate protection rackets as a matter of course. Business owners within a gang's territory (or worse, in the overlapping territories of more than one gang) can expect to pay regularly or risk severe consequences.

items.expectedName: Datapad (Loaded with financial and bookkeeping apps)
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

5OYZcNFkfTO8lGca.name: 炸弹藤
5OYZcNFkfTO8lGca.publicNotes:
炸弹藤是一种美丽但具有爆炸性的多肉植物，在协约世界的许多星舰上作为危险的乘客被发现。原产于卡斯卓韦的热带雨林，炸弹藤的爆炸性名称来源于其藤蔓上悬挂的微微发光的橙色豆荚。这些豆荚是为了防御卡斯卓韦的巨型掠食者而进化出来的防御机制，因为刺和藤蔓被证明是不够的威慑。由于植物的爆炸性豆荚直到完全成熟才会发育，炸弹藤看起来像其他无害的多肉植物（包括与之密切相关且无害的太阳藤），可能会被误认为是低维护的飞船绿化植物。许多园丁在它真正在他们面前爆炸之前，都没有意识到他们正在培育的危险。

As the plant's explosive pods don't develop until full maturity, the string-of-bombs resembles other harmless succulents (including the closely related and harmless string-of-suns) and might be overlooked as low-maintenance ship greenery. Many gardeners remain unaware of the hazard they're cultivating until it literally blows up in their face.

Infestations

Invasive creatures plague Absalom Station and resist the most dedicated efforts to eliminate them. Whether lurking in the Ghost Levels or stowing away on starships, tenacious infestations are a constant problem in such a large and cosmopolitan station.

Mercenaries

So long as the almighty credit can buy power, safety, and comfort, it can also be used to buy violence from the desperate, irrational, and unsentimental. Absalom Station is home to countless mercenary companies and freelance soldiers-for-hire, all eagerly offering their services to the highest bidder.

Some mercs have a moral code or sense of honor that limits what contracts they accept, and Absalom law strictly limits what jobs a paramilitary company can hand out to its members. Of course, this doesn't stop a festering underbelly of wetwork and worse from blooming in the darker reaches of the station, if one knows where to look.

Mercenaries aren't always operatives or soldiers. Sometimes they're cunning spellcasters, powerful solarians, or treacherous envoys. Bounty hunters are one of the most common class of merc hanging around the station. The bounty hunter below is an example of an elite foe tracking down dangerous outlaws, but the statistics for gangsters can stand in for lower-level mercenaries.

You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. 这种替换的机械眼能给予你黑暗视觉。黑视电容型义眼的运作原理是发射低功率的紫外光激光，并透过义眼中的感受器来侦测这些雷射。能看见紫外光的生物可以侦测到这些激光。

items.name: 纳米光学节点
items.expectedDescription:
A crystalline nanocarbon node implanted in your occipital lobe connects to optic nerves by microscopic fibers. You can activate the node to overlay your normal vision with X-ray data. You can deactivate the overlay as a single action, which has the concentrate trait.

Activate—X-Ray Overlay 1 (concentrate)

Effect Your nano-optics node relays collected X-ray data directly to your eyes, overlaying your normal vision. You can see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white. Due to the distracting amount of visual information, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks while the overlay is active.
items.description:
植入枕叶中的纳米碳结晶节点透过极细的光学纤维与你的视神经相连。你可以启动此节点，用X光数据覆盖你的正常视觉。你可以用单动作解除此视觉覆盖，此动作带有专注特征。

aCYxSC8ddmzyivVl.name: 引力子刺客
aCYxSC8ddmzyivVl.publicNotes:
有人说当你凝视虚空时，虚空也凝视着你。但那些引导虚空的人呢？

Assassins for hire tend to be cold pragmatists who might do anything for the right price, but many have their own strange philosophies or belong to obscure cults and religious sects. Deities popular with professional killers include the nihilistic Devourer and cunning Lao Shu Po. Some solarians, like the one below, justify their assassinations as a part of the Cycle necessary to balance the Universe.

Mercenaries

So long as the almighty credit can buy power, safety, and comfort, it can also be used to buy violence from the desperate, irrational, and unsentimental. Absalom Station is home to countless mercenary companies and freelance soldiers-for-hire, all eagerly offering their services to the highest bidder.

Some mercs have a moral code or sense of honor that limits what contracts they accept, and Absalom law strictly limits what jobs a paramilitary company can hand out to its members. Of course, this doesn't stop a festering underbelly of wetwork and worse from blooming in the darker reaches of the station, if one knows where to look.

Mercenaries aren't always operatives or soldiers. Sometimes they're cunning spellcasters, powerful solarians, or treacherous envoys. Bounty hunters are one of the most common class of merc hanging around the station. The bounty hunter below is an example of an elite foe tracking down dangerous outlaws, but the statistics for gangsters can stand in for lower-level mercenaries.

c2rqhARro9iIj8up.name: 太空地精垃圾佬
c2rqhARro9iIj8up.publicNotes:
太空地精垃圾佬潜伏在废铁场（Botscrap）的垃圾场、火花街（Sparks）的工程舱或管道镇（Pipetown）的蜿蜒迷宫中。他们对创造的热爱，与他们对毁灭的造诣不相上下，其中一些地精组成垃圾强盗帮，偷走大而闪亮的科技部件。这些被盗科技随后成为他们谋划建造的下一个科技奇迹的核心部件。

Space Goblins

Goblins are relatively common throughout Absalom Station. Their love of cramped, dark places makes the back alleys and pipelines of the station exceptionally appealing to them. Many goblins are content to live among the populace as merchants, artisans, and cartoonists (with a growing number of goblin publishing houses producing wordless and individualistic "gobbo-comix"), but other goblins have a tendency to make trouble. Some of these tricky troublemakers cause blackouts, fires, and even-greater problems throughout Absalom Station.

items.expectedDescription:
You can ask questions of and receive answers from the spirits inhabiting a computer. These synthetic spirits manifest within computer code and often have personalities colored by the nature of the device, its condition, and its applications and personalized settings. A computer's perspective, perception, and knowledge give it a worldview different enough from a human's that it doesn't consider the same details important. Computers can mostly answer questions about creatures that interfaced with them in the past and what information is concealed within their files.

Heightened (6th) The duration is 8 hours.
items.description:
你可以向居住在电脑中的精魂提问，并从他们那里得到答案。这些合成灵魂会在计算机代码中显现，通常会因设备的性质、状态、应用和个性化设置而具有不同的个性。计算机的视角、感官和知识使它的世界观与人类的世界观大相径庭，以至于它认为某些细节并不重要。计算机能回答的大多数问题都与过去曾与它们互动的生物有关，还有它们的文件中隐藏的信息。

items.description: 镇暴盾用透明铝板制成，以分层的纳米碳纤维板进行加固，在其间填充有聚合物和树脂。这些流线型而坚固的盾牌在举起时能保护持用者大部分身体，同时允许其在密集战术队形中行进。有时候它们透明的盾身便于新手在举盾时观察前方，但资深战士通常无需这样做，而且透明材质被几次命中后便会过度磨损难以看透。

items.name: 删除术
items.expectedDescription:
You delete data from a device or object with a flamboyant magical gesture. This data might be handwritten, printed, or digital. You delete up to 1,500 words' worth of text, one page of content, or one display screen worth of text or other visual information. Non-magical writing in or on an unattended or held object is automatically deleted. Attempt a counteract check to delete digital or magical writing. If you fail to delete writing that's part of a hazard, you trigger the hazard. This can't be used to delete the contents of a spellbook or similar means of storing magical formulas or spells.

If you target an attended tech item with the tracking trait, attempt a counteract check. On a success, the item becomes glitching 1. A creature holding the item can Interact to restart the software, reducing the glitching value by 1.

Heightened (7th) You can delete all the data stored locally on a single device or book, or all the data on a device or book related to a specific name, topic, or category.
items.description:
你以华丽的魔法手势删除设备或物品中的数据。这些数据可以是手写的、打印的或电子的。你最多可以删除 1,500字的文本、一页内容或一显示屏的文本或其他视觉信息。无主物品或手持物品上的非魔法文字会自动删除。尝试反制检定删除数据或魔法文字。如果你尝试删除的文字是危害的一部分，且你失败，就会触发危害。这不能用于删除魔法书或类似的存储魔法公式或法术的内容。

如果目标是具有追踪特征的科技物品，尝试一次反制检定。如果成功，该物品就会获得故障1。持有该物品的生物可以花费一个交互动作来重启用户界面，并将故障值降低1。

升阶（7环）你可以删除单个设备或书籍中本地存储的所有数据，或者删除设备或书籍中与特定名称、主题或类别相关的所有数据。

items.name: 植入数据
items.expectedDescription:
You reprogram a computer or device to display a chosen piece of data when accessed. You can implant up to one piece of data per spell rank. A piece of data can be a simple fact, such as a creature or object's location or physical description; an image of a creature or object; or a simple statement of no more than 300 characters. When the target computer or device is accessed, this implanted data is the first data the accessing creature gains, regardless of what data the creature is looking for. Implanted data doesn't prevent a creature from accessing other information stored on a device, change how the device functions, or otherwise inhibit the device from functioning. If this spell's duration ends before a creature accesses the implanted data, the information vanishes.

Heightened (3rd) The duration is one year.

Heightened (6th) The duration is unlimited.

items.name: 数据板
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.7r6mw8H87SUaj9Tq]

升阶（3环）状态加值提升到+2，并且你可以至多10名生物作为目标。

items.name: 测量术
items.expectedDescription:
You learn the approximate measurements (length, width, depth, height, and weight) of creatures and objects you can observe in the area. If an object or creature extends out of the area, you learn only the measurements within the area, but nothing about what you can't observe. For example, you can't determine the thickness or weight of a wall you can observe only one side of, or the depth of water that extends beyond the spell's range. Each time you Sustain the spell, you learn the exact measurements of one creature or object in the area, including imprecisions or anomalies that might indicate structural weakness. Magically altered targets give you information that reflects what you observe rather than accurate measurements.

Heightened (+1) Extend the range of measure by 100 feet.
items.description:
你可以了解周围生物和物体的大致尺寸（长度、宽度、深度、高度和重量）。如果物体或生物延伸出了该射程，你只能了解该区域内的测量值，而无法观察到的东西则无法了解。例如，你无法确定只能观察到一面的墙壁的厚度或重量，也无法确定超出法术射程的水深。每次维持法术时，你都会了解该区域内一种生物或物体的精确测量结果，包括可能揭示结构弱点的不精确或异常现象。被魔法改变的目标所提供的信息反映的是你所观察到的情况，而不是精确测量值。

升阶（+1）延展测量距离100尺。

items.name: 数据板
items.expectedDescription: These ubiquitous handheld computers incorporate a comm unit, microphone, speaker, camera, infosphere browser, and data storage. They can store thousands of hours of recordings, play games, and perform simple computing functions, such as time tracking and notifications, word processing, calculations, data processing, streaming media, and broadcasting emergency alerts from local governments. In most societies, commercial datapads are relatively flimsy, designed to rapidly wear out or fall behind on the latest features and updates to encourage the consumer to replace it with a newer model. In contrast, higher-end datapads are made to last and often include a sturdier chassis and extra functions.
items.description: 此类泛用手持计算机集成了通讯单元，麦克风，扬声器，摄像头，信息圈浏览器以及数据存储功能。其可以存储数千小时的记录，支持游玩游戏和执行简单的计算功能（如计时提醒，文本处理，计算，数据处理，流媒体以及当地政府的紧急广播）。在大多数社群里，商用型数据板相当脆弱，刻意设计以快速损坏或被最新的特性和更新淘汰，以此来刺激消费者置换更新的型号。相比之下，高端的数据板旨在长期使用，且通常包含更坚固的框架和额外功能。

items.name: 奥术科技数据平板
items.expectedDescription: The agent can cast spells only so long as their datapad is intact, not glitching, and on the agent's person.
items.description: 特工只有在数据板完好，未处于故障状态且在身上时才能施放法术。

items.name: 白盔协议
items.expectedDescription: The glitching values of all items worn or held by the agent are reduced by 1.
items.description: 特工穿戴或持握的所有物品的故障值减少1。

items.name: 切割现实
items.expectedDescription:
You slice through reality, forming a chasm of life-draining entropy in a straight line 20 feet high, 120 feet long, and 2 inches thick. The chasm provides cover. The chasm deals 7d8 void damage to each creature that's in the chasm's space when it's created, that attempts to pass through the chasm, or that ends its turn inside the chasm, with a basic Reflex save. A creature that succeeds at this save when the chasm is created is pushed to the nearest space on the side of its choice. Creatures trying to move through the chasm fail to do so if they critically fail the save, ending their movement next to the chasm.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.
items.description:
你划破现实，在一条20尺高、120尺长、2英寸厚的直线上形成一道能使生命流失的熵裂隙。裂隙提供掩蔽。裂隙会对在形成时位于其空间内、试图穿过裂隙或在裂隙内结束回合的每个生物造成7d8虚能伤害，具有一次基础反射豁免。如果生物在裂隙形成时豁免成功，则会被推到其选择的一侧最近的空间。试图穿过裂隙的生物如果豁免失败，就会在裂隙旁结束移动。

升阶（+1）伤害增加 1d8。

You unleash a ray of entropy that rapidly and indiscriminately decays matter. Make a ranged spell attack against the target's AC. On a hit, the target takes 5d8 void damage, or it takes 2d6 persistent acid damage and is glitching 1 if it has the tech trait. On a critical hit, double the damage, and if the creature has the tech trait, it's glitching 2 and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1 die.

你释放一束熵射线，迅速且无差别地分解物质。进行远程法术攻击对抗目标的AC。如果命中，目标受到5d8虚能伤害；或者如果目标生物有科技特征，则会受到2d6持续性酸蚀伤害并陷入故障1。如果重击，伤害翻倍，并且如果目标生物有科技特征，则陷入故障2和@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{震慑 Stunned 1}。

p2FidtuGWhxZoLQM.publicNotes:
年轻或不明智的太空地精令人沮丧地容易被说服参与盗窃或暴力。这些小家伙在事情出错时逃跑的速度与投入战斗的速度一样快，他们困扰着任何愚蠢到敢在艾巴萨罗姆空间站粗野街区旅行的外来者。

Space Goblins

Goblins are relatively common throughout Absalom Station. Their love of cramped, dark places makes the back alleys and pipelines of the station exceptionally appealing to them. Many goblins are content to live among the populace as merchants, artisans, and cartoonists (with a growing number of goblin publishing houses producing wordless and individualistic "gobbo-comix"), but other goblins have a tendency to make trouble. Some of these tricky troublemakers cause blackouts, fires, and even-greater problems throughout Absalom Station.

xZf2UldYXXvVZe3p.name: 帮派头目
xZf2UldYXXvVZe3p.publicNotes:
只有最无情的人才能爬上顶端成为帮派头目。

Gangsters

Criminal guilds, crime families, protection rackets, and loan sharks are just a few of the many types of gangs in Absalom Station. Gangs are highly localized, predatory, and extremely territorial. Members join for different reasons, but most find that once they're in a gang, there's no easy way out.

Gangsters always have hustles, criminal industries they use to make money, but most also operate protection rackets as a matter of course. Business owners within a gang's territory (or worse, in the overlapping territories of more than one gang) can expect to pay regularly or risk severe consequences.
